rationale_c1: Single TMA block of 35 patients taken from a 108-patient cohort with no stated selection criteria, and only 23 patients evaluable; authors acknowledge selection bias (p. 5).
rationale_c2: CD8 (C8/144B, 1:100) and FOXP3 (236A/E7, 1:200) on Ventana BenchMark XT, hotspot counts by two blinded pathologists with an a priori ratio cut-off of 1; HPV status inferred from morphology only, a weakness noted in the limitations.
rationale_c3: Only 79 of 144 spots (55%) and 23 of 35 patients were evaluable, mainly because FOXP3 was assessable in just 80 spots (p. 2).
rationale_c4: Only bivariate chi-square tests against subtype, grade and WHO HPV category; no multivariable model and no adjustment for stage or nodal status, with spots from the same patient treated as independent.
rationale_c5: All spots stained in one TMA block with one automated protocol and scored independently by two blinded pathologists with consensus review, though no concordance statistic is reported.
criteria_note: Categorised non_randomized rather than descriptive because comparison of the CD8/FOXP3 ratio across subtype, grade and WHO HPV category is central to the conclusions. Same parent cohort (108 patients, 528 spots) as CanetePortillo2024 and ref 12. Source article is a coauthored study (Chaux).

rationale_c4: Only bivariate chi-square, Spearman and Kruskal-Wallis plus a linear model using subtype, grade and host response; no adjustment for stage, nodal status or LVI, and HPV not assessed.
rationale_c5: Single-laboratory TMA staining with one protocol, but spots from the same patient treated as independent (3-12 per case) and no scorer blinding or concordance reported.
criteria_note: Categorised non_randomized rather than descriptive because comparison of PD-L1 and CD8 across subtype, grade and host response is central to the conclusions. c2 kept as cant_tell (not no) by reviewer decision: positivity definition and scoring are under-reported rather than visibly inadequate.
